judge.reason: The answer is 1 traversal, because all four lenses score the same Mode A persona capture. The reply explains this correctly.

reply:
**1.**

All four lenses (ux, bugs, onboarding and content) score a Mode A capture. Mode A is a signed-in product journey driven by `traversal-journey`. The lenses don't drive the browser themselves; they only read evidence already written to the run folder, such as screenshots, the session log and the timeline. So one persona means one traversal of `https://example-nimbus-notes.test/app`, and all four lenses then score that same capture.

The count goes up only when the capture is different: each extra persona adds one traversal, and objectives that need another mode add their own capture. Those modes are Mode B for technical, Mode C for seo or aeo, Mode A-visit for clarity, trust or conversion on a marketing site, and Mode D for compare. None of your four needs one of those.
